dedupe_keys.name: dhaka lte handover pilot drive test measurements

description: This pilot collection records LTE signal conditions and handover behaviour along a thirteen-kilometre route from Le Meridien Dhaka to BRAC University, Bangladesh. Islamic University of Technology researchers use XCAL-M, a Samsung handset and positioning equipment during three evening drive tests. Raw material includes radio measurements, layer-three signalling and diagnostic logs; processed tables align timestamps, interpolate missing values and apply a 320-millisecond time-to-trigger context to handover labels. Mendeley version 2 distributes two RAR archives with CSV, TXT and DRM material, free under CC BY 4.0. Exact dates and a common sampling interval are not established in the short metadata. Limited routes and sessions constrain generalization, and interpolated values must remain distinct from measurements. A reviewer-assessed use is testing mobility and handover assumptions in urban cellular simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, without a checked conversion. No archive, proprietary log viewer or reinforcement-learning environment was run.
